experiment_data.hypothesis: DDR features have causal predictive power for depth beyond correlation: permutation importance confirms each feature group (drifting/stationary) contributes independently, and Granger causality tests show depth-t features predict depth-(t+1) features beyond autoregressive baseline, establishing temporal causal direction in the generation chain
experiment_data.notes: 脚本 444 行，3 模块（permutation/granger/intervention）已实现并 dry-run 验证。全部 CPU-bound，不需要 GPU。数据: features_8gen.csv 37058 行。预估: Granger ~2min, Permutation ~15min, Intervention ~45min，可并行。

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/gen-depth-fingerprint && python3 scripts/ddr_causal_analysis.py --module permutation --n-repeats 50 --output results/ddr_causal_permutation.json && python3 scripts/ddr_causal_analysis.py --module granger --output results/ddr_causal_granger.json && python3 scripts/ddr_causal_analysis.py --module intervention --n-repeats 30 --output results/ddr_causal_intervention.json"
